meta.title: About D-SAP Ghule Tutorials, since {{fact:org.founded#year}}
meta.description: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials began in {{fact:org.founded#place}} in {{fact:org.founded#year}}. Today it runs JEE coaching in Pune, powered by a top Kota institute.

intro: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials started in {{fact:org.founded#year}} as a small coaching class in {{fact:org.founded#place}}, founded by {{fact:org.founder#name}}.

sections.heading: {{fact:org.founder#name}}
body: {{fact:org.founder#name}} has been teaching for {{fact:org.founder#teachingYears}} years, and founded D-SAP Ghule Tutorials in {{fact:org.founded#year}}. The guides on this site are written by {{fact:org.founder#name}}.

sections.heading: From one class to two centres
body: More than {{fact:org.students}} students have studied with us since {{fact:org.founded#year}}, in school and entrance exam courses. Today we teach at two centres, the head office in {{fact:org.founded#place}} and a branch in Wakad.

sections.heading: The JEE programme, powered by Kota

body.text: Our JEE programme is powered by a top coaching institute in Kota, and faculty from Kota teach it. [Powered by Kota](page:powered-by-kota) explains what the affiliation covers.
